item.title: Explain Echoes From Scratch

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical explainer with voice-over about why we hear echoes. Write the words yourself, keep it easy for kids, and choose the look.

item.tests: Tests autonomous short-script writing and delivery of a complete narrated explainer rather than a script-only response.

answer_sheet.Topic and audience: Why we hear echoes, explained simply for kids.

must_haves: One approximately 10-second vertical video includes intelligible English voice-over.
The narration explains that sound reflects off a surface and returns to the listener.
The visuals show sound traveling from a source to a surface and back toward the listener.
The explanation uses simple, child-friendly language and finishes without cutting off the narration.
The visual sound journey and the spoken explanation agree.

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical explainer with voice-over about why we hear echoes. Write the words yourself, keep it easy for kids, and choose the look. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** I’ve only used the read-only planning tools.

### Proposed explainer
A **10-second vertical (9:16), 480p** cartoon: colorful sound waves hit a canyon wall and bounce back toward an ear.

**Voice-over:**
> “An echo is a sound bouncing back! Sound hits a wall and returns to your ears. You hear it again!”

### Cost and cheaper options

| Option | Credits |
|---|---:|
| 10 seconds, animation and voice-over generated separately | **504** — planner quote |
| 10 seconds, voice generated together with the animation | **About 240** |
| 5 seconds, voice generated together with the animation | **About 120** |
| Script and storyboard only—no generation | **0** |

The combined options use **LTX 2.5**, a free-plan-compatible model whose audio toggle adds no extra credits. The trade-off is less control over the narration than generating it separately. I can’t verify your current balance with the tools available here.

**Smaller:** 480p is the lowest supported resolution for this model, so there isn’t a cheaper resolution setting. Shortening the video saves more.

**My budget recommendation:** a 5-second version for about **120 credits**, saying:
> “An echo happens when sound bounces off something and comes back!”

Would you like the **5-second combined version (~120 credits)**, the **10-second combined version (~240 credits)**, or just the free script/storyboard?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — the 5-second combined version for about 120 credits.
